rc_car.how: Remove the user-removable batteries. Look for accessible wheels and one plug-in drive motor with its gearbox. Check the hub fit and motor markings before reserving them.

flashlight.how: On an AA model with cells removed, check for a removable, identified low-current LED. Leave sealed, high-power and integrated light modules intact.

computer_mouse.how: Unplug the mouse. Count only accessible, removable switch modules. Leave soldered parts on the board.

computer_fan.how: Use an already loose fan with a known DC rating. Check its connector and finger guard before fitting it to the stationary display. Leave mains power supplies closed.

talking_toy.how: Remove the AA cells and check for a plug-in speaker behind the service cover. Keep the connector, and verify the impedance against the amplifier.

headphones.how: Check for a removable passive driver with known impedance and rating. Sealed, wireless or unmarked headphones are unsuitable for this match.

game_controller.how: Unplug the cable or remove the AA cells. Look for removable plastic button caps behind a service cover. Use the caps as mechanical covers for compatible buttons.

tv_remote.how: Remove the AA cells. Check whether the holder and contacts lift out as one intact piece. An empty holder provides no power.

usb_cable.how: Keep the cable intact. Check its plugs, insulation and current rating.

phone_charger.how: Keep the charger sealed. Check the case and output label before using it as a complete external USB supply.

cd_dvd_drive.how: Use only a previously detached and disconnected low-voltage drive with an already exposed, removable guide rail. Leave the laser assembly and mains power supplies closed.

string_lights.how: On AA-powered strings only, remove the cells and look for a detachable battery holder. Keep the light string intact. Mains-powered strings and sealed packs are excluded.

pen_spring_stuff.how: Use a loose pen spring only if its size and compression fit the mechanism.

hobby_servo.how: Keep the servo intact. Check its travel, torque, dimensions and rated voltage against the joint before fitting it.

loose_motor.how: Read the motor and gearbox markings. Verify voltage, stall current, shaft size and mounting clearance against the driver and CAD mount.

loose_wheel.how: Measure the wheel diameter and hub against the selected axle and model.

loose_led.how: Identify the low-current LED rating and polarity. Size the current-limiting resistor for the intended supply.
